Name: Primitive Automate (Early and Cheaper Hoppers)
Author: Stultzyboi
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/mI1cYmI.png[/img]﻿
Primitive Automate is a Content Patcher mod designed to both reduce the cost of the hopper and move it to an earlier game item. It has a good selection of configuration options to set up the cost and acquisition manner in the way that fits your play style the most. Originally designed as a way to replace automate when using the Walk of Life mod so that you can still benefit from all of the mods wonderful perks while still having some degree of automation in your game. With that said, it also works completely fine as a stand alone QoL change and makes for a nice alternative to Automate for those who find the automation a tad overpowered.

Safe to install mid-game. If you choose an option that adds a scenario where you should already have the recipe unlocked, it'll become unlocked after going to sleep.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/A2NR4JR.png[/img]

﻿﻿﻿Requires both SMAPI and Content Patcher to use. Simply extract and drop into your mod folder. It's also recommended to use Generic Mod Config Menu for easy changes to the mods options.

[b]Available recipe cost options:[/b]

[b]Copper & Wood:[/b] ﻿Wood - 50, Copper Bar - 5
﻿[b]Iron & Hardwood (default):[/b] Hardwood - 10, Iron Bar - 5
[b]Gold & Clay: [/b]Hardwood - 10, Gold Bar - 5, Clay - 3
[b]Iridium & Battery:[/b] Hardwood - 10, Iridium Bar - 1, Battery - 1
[b]Vanilla: [/b]Hardwood - 10, Iridium Bar - 1, Radioactive Bar - 1

[b]Available recipe [/b][b]unlock options:[/b]

[b]Start With Recipe:[/b] Start the game with the recipe
[b]Farming Lvl 4 (default):[/b] Unlocked when reaching level 4 Farming
[b]Farming Lvl 9:[/b] Unlocked when reaching level 9 Farming
[b]Buy From Robin: [/b]Buy from Robin for 5000g
[b]Vanilla:[/b] Buy from Qi's Gem Shop on Ginger Island

In addition, the mod by default removes the ability to buy individual hoppers from Qi's Gem Shop, however this can be disabled in the config so that Mr. Qi will still sell them in your game.

If you're wondering which combo of cost/unlock to use:
[b]Copper & Wood + Start with Recipe:[/b] Barely more expensive than most basic machines and great for those who want to automate
[b]Default Options:[/b]  Slightly more expensive and requires around a season of non-automation to get to a good place to begin crafting the hoppers. I think this one feels the best
[b]Gold & Clay + Farming Lvl 9:[/b] Puts the progress towards around the time you would naturally reach the end of the regular mines and is good for some year 2+ automation.
I also think Buy From Robin is a good option for any option and allows you to decide when you want to buy the recipe and is a pretty good investment to buy between the 1st and 2nd backpack upgrades.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0O16Hg4.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[center]As mentioned, I came up with the idea for this mod when using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of Life[/url]. Walk of Life has a few notable perks that don't activate when using Automate. Because of this using Automate with Walk Of Life can detract from the overall experience of the mod. In testing, I found that the perks do work with hoppers, but considering the awful location and price of the vanilla hopper, even with the perks added, it was still hardly worth using. I love Walk of Life a lot and recommend it for everyone, be sure to check it out.

There isn't much use to using this mod along with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url], but even still because it's the mod I used for the bulk of my automation needs during previous playthroughs it is always worth shouting out.

If you wonder why I went about making the changes this mod has, it is because It's what I wanted in my game, plain in simple. I ditched the automate system entirely to get automation to work with Walk of Life. I didn't make any changes to how the hopper physically works because [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24332]DaLionHeart [/url]﻿already does a great job at upgrading the functionality of the hopper enough (hoppers can auto extract completed items out of the same hopper that inserted the item into the machine, so no 2 hopper per machine set-ups). Plus, I consider 1 automation machine per 1 standard machine to be peak balanced design, eliminating the, as I see it, unbalanced one cheap chest automating any number of machines. From an immersive field of view, I find that having a dedicated machine to handle automations more believable than a chest that simply magically does it. I do find [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22672]Junimatic [/url]﻿to be the most immersive, and just downright cute, but that unfortunately runs into the same issues with the Walk of Life crafting perks as well (which I'm pretty sure was a design choice by the developer of the mod, because it's the junimos doing the work and not you, but if it ever was given the option to activate the perks I'd switch in a heartbeat). As far as what I consider the best spot to gain automation, it is right where I put the default values for this mod; right at the roundabout area, you would get the artisan perk.[/center]
